context:
Closed on your note, 14:40 CDT: you keep the apps' access to claude-settings as is, because it makes calling into a repo straightforward; revisit if it gets bloated. Nothing changes.

The item asked whether three outside apps (Renovate, Cloudflare, Render) should keep access to claude-settings.
ref: c153 (each installed GitHub app needs the repo)
steps: Open the Installed GitHub apps link below, then click Configure beside each app (Renovate, Cloudflare, Render).
Under Repository access, if the app does not use claude-settings, remove claude-settings from its list and save.
Mark done with a note of what you removed; a session then checks each app's last activity.
title: Remove claude-settings from GitHub apps that do not use it
